label: Class Challenge
description: A class sets a challenge: a puzzle in the classroom, a thing to find on the grounds, a creature to calm, or a lesson to survive. Complete it to earn the class reward.

label: Spell Research
description: Research a new spell or recover a lost one. Each advance is a period of study, experiment, and dangerous trial.

label: Potion Research
description: Develop a new potion or refine an old recipe. Each advance is a batch, a failure, and a better note in the margin.

label: Enchantment Research
description: Design a new enchantment. Each advance is a test object, a binding, and a flaw discovered before it matters.
